observations.body: Skip to content PROGRAMMING ⌄ ♧ Reserve → JAZZ LOUNGE & SUPPER CLUB • DOWNTOWN Sonic Gastronomy for nights that linger. The Midnight Note is a charcoal-dark listening room where brass glows, plates arrive on cue, and every set is paced like a tasting menu. Reserve a table for tonight’s program—or apply for membership to unlock late-night access and cellar selections. Reserve Seats → Explore Tonight’s Lineup → Doors 6:30 • First set 7:30 Chef’s Tasting (5 courses) • Limited Dress: evening casual Tonight • “Blue Hour” Trio • 9:45 set A slow-rotating brass ring echoes cymbal shimmer—our signature motif for sound in motion. Sensory Pillars Three entrances to the same night: the music, the menu, and the room itself. Tap a pillar to expand the experience. Listen Curated sets with vinyl warmth and stage intimacy. ♬ Taste Seasonal courses timed to the set list. ♧ Listening Room Protocol Our stage is mixed for clarity, not volume. Sets are framed by short intermissions—enough time to refresh a drink, not enough to break the spell. House system tuned for upright bass definition and cymbal air. Vinyl prelude from the club library before each first set. Quiet service choreography: menus land between tunes. Explore Taste → Artist Lineup Four pillars of sound, each with its own cadence. Filter by vibe to shape your night. The residency defined our sound: a bass you can trace with your eyes, a ride cymbal that blooms instead of bites. Journal / Backstage Notes from the room: how we build the menu, tune the system, and program the night. Spotlight 7 min read Interview with the Musical Director On pacing a night like a record: side A for clarity, side B for heat, and an encore that feels like a secret track. Noah K. • Programming → Kitchen 5 min read Why our tasting menu lands between tunes Timing is a flavor. We design each course so the last bite resolves before the next downbeat.
